draft: A handover note has unsaved changes
pending: A handover note's save result needs checking
pendingNotice: The save result has not been confirmed. Your input stays here. Check the current note before saving again; leaving does not cancel an operation already submitted.
failed: The saved note could not be checked. Your input stays here; try checking again when connected.
different: The current saved note does not match the submitted version. Review it below. No save was repeated, and your input has been kept above.
useCurrentConfirm: Replace your input with the checked note and its sharing choice? This does not cancel a submitted save. A later save may require another check.
discardConfirm: Return to the last confirmed note and sharing choice? This only changes your input; it does not save or delete a note.
